verdict.rationale: EFTPS is an online payment service, so issuing scoped agent credentials is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence shows no API credential issuance of any kind. Authentication is interactive MFA through Login.gov, ID.me or PIV/CAC; the only software channel is the Batch Provider program rather than an API; and probes for OpenAPI specs returned 404s. MFA and multi-client tax-professional logins are adjacent controls, not least-privilege API tokens, so they earn no credit.
